name: Evil Incarnate
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Devil Masks.
At the start of each player's turn, that player chooses one of his creatures and destroys it.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: "It's good to be bad!"

name: Heavyweight Dragon
rulesText:
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
Instead of having this creature attack, you may tap it to use its $tap ability.
$tap Choose up to 2 of your opponent's tapped creatures in the battle zone. If they have total power less than this creature's power, destroy them.

name: Diamondia, the Blizzard Rider
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Snow Faeries.
When you put this creature into the battle zone, return all Snow Faeries from your graveyard and your mana zone to your hand.
flavorText: "Winter's coming early this year!"

name: Miraculous Snare
rulesText:
(This spell is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Choose a non-evolution creature in the battle zone and add it to its owner's shields face down.
flavorText: The veil between realities is as beautiful as it is stifling.

name: Miraculous Truce
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it for no cost.)
(This spell is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Choose a civilization. Until the start of your next turn, creatures of that civilization can't attack you even if your opponent puts them into the battle zone after you cast this spell.

name: Asra, Vizier of Safety
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : This creature gets +4000 power and has "Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle)."

name: Baraid, the Explorer
rulesText: Silent skill (At the start of each of your turns, if this creature is tapped, you may keep it tapped and use its Silent skill ability.) : Your light creatures can't be blocked this turn.
flavorText: It has no propulsion system. Instead, it moves by creating tiny vortex portals and warping itself a foot at a time.

name: Belix, the Explorer
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
When you put this creature into the battle zone, return a spell from your mana zone to your hand.
This creature can't attack players.
flavorText: It doesn't breathe oxygen-it breathes neon.

name: Engbelt, the Spydroid
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
This creature can't attack players.
flavorText: "I caught a jumbo jet in my web once. It was mighty tasty."

name: Lamiel, Destiny Enforcer
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : Whenever one of your creatures is destroyed during your opponent's turn, you may draw a card.
flavorText: From a ripple to a swell to a crest to a tsunami.

name: Merlee, the Oracle
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : Each of your creatures in the battle zone gets +1000 power.
flavorText: It always makes its point.

name: Nial, Vizier of Dexterity
rulesText: At the end of each of your turns, you may untap this creature.
flavorText: "Everyone always makes fun of my pointy head. Can't they make fun of my stubby feet for a change?"

name: Solar Trap
rulesText: Choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone and tap it.
flavorText: Children from the Darkness civilization are regularly warned that it isn't safe to go out before dark.

name: Yuliana, Channeler of Suns
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
Whenever your opponent would choose a creature in the battle zone, he can't choose this one. (It can still be attacked and blocked.)
This creature can't attack players.

name: Aqua Trickster
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : When you put this creature into the battle zone, choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone and tap it.
flavorText: "Tickle, tickle . . . ."

name: Emergency Typhoon
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it for no cost.)
Draw up to 2 cards. Then discard a card from your hand.
flavorText: "Effective? Yes. Subtle? Not so much." —Zaltan

name: Fantasy Fish
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it for no cost.)
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
flavorText: It's not an eel. It's not an illusion. It's an eelusion.

name: Lucky Ball
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, if your opponent has 3 or fewer shields, draw up to 2 cards.
flavorText: It's as mercurial and capricious as someone who knows a lot of really big words.

name: Melodic Hunter
rulesText: Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
flavorText: "Your heartbeat is throwing off the rhythm of our aquatic melody. Let's see what we can do about that."

name: Revival Soldier
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker abilities.) : This creature gets +4000 power. : When this creature would be destroyed, return it to your hand instead.
flavorText: "What? Haven't you ever seen ears before?"

name: Squawking Lunatron
rulesText: Silent skill (At the start of each of your turns, if this creature is tapped, you may keep it tapped and use its Silent skill ability.) : Return up to 3 cards from your mana zone to your hand.
flavorText: "The quest for knowledge will never end. It might take a break every now and then-maybe sneak in a quick nap-but end? Never!" —Milporo

name: Time Scout
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, look at the top card of your opponent's deck.
flavorText: "The speed of time is holding steady at one second per second. Tomorrow is on track to arrive as scheduled. All's quiet on the temporal front."

name: Warped Lunatron
rulesText:
Creatures in the battle zone don't untap at the start of each player's turn.
When each player untaps his cards at the start of his turn, he may then tap any number of cards in his mana zone. For every 2 cards he taps this way, he untaps one of his creatures in the battle zone.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)

name: Baira, the Hidden Lunatic
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
This creature can't attack.
When this creature battles, destroy it after the battle.
flavorText: It further blurs the fuzzy line between weird and freaky.

name: Beratcha, the Hidden Glutton
rulesText: Slayer (Whenever this creature battles, destroy the other creature after the battle.)
flavorText: It has waited for countless years, endlessly repeating the same silent plea whenever a potential victim passed by its lock: "Open me . . . open me . . . open me . . ."

name: Gazer Eyes, Shadow of Secrets
rulesText: Silent skill (At the start of each of your turns, if this creature is tapped, you may keep it tapped and use its Silent skill ability.) : Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card from it. Your opponent discards that card.
flavorText: "Be careful when you gaze into the darkness. It might gaze back." —Yuliana, Channeler of Suns

name: Hazaria, Duke of Thorns
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : When you put this creature into the battle zone, your opponent chooses one of his creatures and destroys it.
flavorText: "Darling! I got you some roses!"

name: Jagila, the Hidden Pillager
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : When you put this creature into the battle zone, your opponent discards 3 cards at random from his hand.
flavorText: Its inner lining is made of fear . . . and velvet . . . but mostly fear.

name: Morbid Medicine
rulesText: Return up to 2 creatures from your graveyard to your hand.
flavorText: "You may call it a grotesque perversion of nature, but I call it-actually, I kinda like the sound of that. Grotesque perversion of nature. Yeah, you nailed it."

name: Roulette of Ruin
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it for no cost.)
Choose a number. Show your hand to your opponent and discard from it each card that has that cost. Then your opponent shows you his hand and discards from it each card that has that cost.

name: Saliva Worm
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : This creature gets +4000 power and has "Darkness stealth (This creature can't be blocked while your opponent has any darkness cards in his mana zone)."

name: Spinning Terror, the Wretched
rulesText: This creature gets +2000 power for each tapped creature your opponent has in the battle zone.
flavorText: "I'm famous for my wheely bad puns."

name: Bonfire Lizard
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : When you put this creature into the battle zone, destroy up to 2 of your opponent's creatures that have "blocker."
flavorText: "Everything was under control until I tried to roast marshmallows on it." —Aqua Trickster

name: Brad's Cutter
rulesText: Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it for no cost.)
flavorText: "It's just what I need for slicing cheese, trimming hedges, and turning ultra-armored sky tanks into scrap metal." —Brad, Super Kickin' Dynamo

name: Eviscerating Warrior Lumez
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : When you put this creature into the battle zone, destroy all creatures that have power 2000 or less.
flavorText: "My favorite color is burnt, burnt, burnt sienna."

name: Gankloak, Rogue Commando
rulesText: Silent skill (At the start of each of your turns, if this creature is tapped, you may keep it tapped and use its Silent skill ability.) : Each of your fire creatures in the battle zone gets "double breaker" until the end of the turn. (It breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: "Am I macho enough yet?"

name: Hysteria Lizard
rulesText:
This creature attacks each turn if able.
Power attacker +3000 (While attacking, this creature gets +3000 power.)
flavorText: "Of course it's hot headed! The coolest its head ever gets is 800 degrees!" —Tajimal, Vizier of Aqua

name: Jabaha's Automaton
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Xenoparts.
Power attacker +4000 (While attacking, this creature gets +4000 power.)
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: All it leaves in its wake are craters, pools of motor oil, and rusty gears.

name: Lockdown Lizard
rulesText: Players can't use the  abilities of their creatures.
flavorText: "Melt Warriors have more in common with salamanders, the mythical fire spirits, than they do with lizards. Unfortunately, they're not nearly as mythical." —Hokira

name: Sapian Tark, Flame Dervish
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : This creature gets +4000 power and can attack untapped creatures.
flavorText: He uses the flame that burns in his heart to ignite another one on your head.

name: Ten-Ton Crunch
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it for no cost.)
Destroy one of your opponent's creatures that has power 3000 or less.
flavorText: "To be honest, we don't really know if it's ten tons. Whenever we try to weigh it, the scale breaks." —Slaphappy Soldier

name: Hazard Hopper
rulesText: At the end of each of your turns, if this creature broke any shields that turn, return it to your hand.
flavorText: "Hrmph! The situation didn't get hazardous until it hopped here." —Scowling Tomato

name: Hearty Cap'n Polligon
rulesText: At the end of each of your turns, if this creature broke any shields that turn, return it to your hand.
flavorText: "I sail the frozen seas. I ride the glacial breeze. I sing yo-ho and a yo-ho-ho. Oh no-here come the trees!"

name: Macho Melon
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : Power attacker +3000 (While attacking, this creature gets +3000 power.)
flavorText: "Hey baby-knock on my rind."

name: Ninja Pumpkin
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : This creature gets +4000 power and can't be blocked by any creature that has power 5000 or less.
flavorText: This mysterious hero endlessly battles against pie bakers, the enemies of Wild Veggies everywhere.

name: Quillspike Rumbler
rulesText: Whenever this creature attacks a creature, this creature gets +3000 power until the end of the turn.
flavorText: The three most dangerous things to do in the forest are lick Poisonous Dahlia, clip Stratosphere Giant's toenails, and give Quillspike Rumbler a back rub.

name: Rainbow Gate
rulesText: Search your deck. You may take a multi-colored creature from your deck, show that creature to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.
flavorText: Ten thousand miles away, Bombazar's Dragon hockey team suddenly found itself a player short.

name: Rollicking Totem
rulesText: Silent skill (At the start of each of your turns, if this creature is tapped, you may keep it tapped and use its Silent skill ability.) : Put a creature that has Dragon in its race from your mana zone into the battle zone.
flavorText: "Camouflage? That's a funny word. What's it mean?"

name: Royal Durian
rulesText: Silent skill (At the start of each of your turns, if this creature is tapped, you may keep it tapped and use its Silent skill ability.) : Put a creature that has Dragon in its race from your mana zone into the battle zone.

name: Skyscraper Shell
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : When you put this creature into the battle zone, your opponent chooses one of his creatures in the battle zone and puts it into his mana zone.

name: Rise and Shine
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it for no cost.)
(This spell is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Put one of them that has "blocker" into your hand, and put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Live and Breathe
rulesText:
(This spell is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Whenever you summon a creature this turn, search your deck. You may take a creature from your deck that has the same name as that creature and put it into the battle zone. Then shuffle your deck.
flavorText: "The 5:15 rift in the universe is early today." —Techno Totem

name: Hide and Seek
rulesText:
(This spell is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Choose one of your opponent's non-evolution creatures in the battle zone and return it to his hand. Then he discards a card at random from his hand.
flavorText: "Brace yourselves! It's a Class 5 Metaphor!" —Shaman Broccoli

name: Slash and Burn
rulesText:
(This spell is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Whenever any of your opponent's creatures is destroyed this turn, your opponent chooses a card in his mana zone and puts it into his graveyard. Then he chooses one of his shields and puts it into his graveyard.
flavorText: This is what happens when nightmares have nightmares.

name: Reap and Sow
rulesText:
(This spell is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Choose a card in your opponent's mana zone and put it into his graveyard. Then put the top card of your deck into your mana zone.
flavorText: "Only those who don't understand call it chaos. The rest call it life." —Gonta, the Warrior Savage

name: Warlord Ailzonius
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Gladiators.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
Whenever your opponent would choose a creature in the battle zone, he can't choose this one. (It can still be attacked and blocked.)
flavorText: It knows when war is coming because it decides when war is coming.

name: Klujadras
rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : When you put this creature into the battle zone, each player draws a card for each of his creatures in the battle zone that has "wave striker."
flavorText: "Now you see why I failed biology." —Gankloak, Rogue Commando

name: Miraculous Plague
rulesText:
(This spell is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Choose 2 of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone. Your opponent chooses one of them, puts it into his hand, and destroys the other one. Then choose 2 cards in your opponent's mana zone. Your opponent chooses one of them, puts it into his hand, and puts the other one into his graveyard.

name: Miraculous Meltdown
rulesText:
(This spell is put into your mana zone tapped.)
You can cast this spell only if your opponent has more shields than you do.
Your opponent chooses one of his shields for each shield you have. He puts the rest of his shields into his hand. (He can use the "shield trigger" abilities of those shields.)

name: Miraculous Rebirth
rulesText:
(This spell is put into your mana zone tapped.)
Destroy one of your opponent's creatures that has power 5000 or less. When your opponent puts that creature into his graveyard, search your deck. You may take a creature from your deck that has the same cost as that creature and put it into the battle zone. Then shuffle your deck.
